assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: SITE_BOUNDARY and KEY_AREA use the repository's provisional rough polygons.
assumptions.impact: All spatial areas support intake and design discussion only; official polygons must replace them and trigger a full geometry and metrics recalculation.

assumptions.statement: Global cases, operating mechanisms, logo direction, scenario cards, and landmarks are public background research and conceptual proposals.
assumptions.impact: They do not constitute institutional endorsement, enterprise commitment, funding, policy, investment, or approved operation.

assumptions.statement: Transport, municipal, heritage, ownership, fire, energy, rail interface, and existing-building data are not included in the public site package.
assumptions.impact: Alignment, demolition/retention, intensity, height, service capacity, and engineering feasibility remain pending.
